title: Deep Barycentric Regression for Optimal Transport Map Estimation and its Statistical Optimality
abstract: arXiv:2609.06598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The optimal transport (OT) map provides a geometric transformation for aligning probability distributions and has become a useful tool in machine learning. However, existing estimators of the OT map still exhibit a gap between sharp statistical guarantees and practical parametric estimation based on stable training objectives. Theoretical estimators achieve minimax optimal convergence rates, but they are typically nonparametric and can incur demanding implementation design or inference costs. Practical estimators are parametric and scalable, but their statistical guarantees remain underexplored, and their min-max, adversarial-like training objectives can be sensitive to optimization algorithms. We propose BROT (Barycentric Regression for OT), a simple two-step method that first computes the unregularized OT plan and then fits a deep neural network (DNN) to the induced barycentric targets by least-squares regression. translated_title: 面向最优传输映射估计及其统计最优性的深度重心回归
translated_abstract: 最优传输（OT）映射提供了一种用于对齐概率分布的几何变换，并已成为机器学习中的实用工具。然而，现有的OT映射估计器在严格的统计保证与基于稳定训练目标的实用参数化估计之间仍存在差距。理论性估计器能够达到极小化极大（minimax）最优收敛速度，但它们通常是非参数化的，可能需要苛刻的实现设计或高昂的推断成本。实用估计器则是参数化且可扩展的，但其统计保证仍未被充分研究，且其极小极大式的类对抗训练目标可能对优化算法较为敏感。我们提出了BROT（Barycentric Regression for OT，最优传输重心回归），这是一种简单的两步方法：首先计算未正则化的OT方案，然后通过最小二乘回归将深度神经网络（DNN）拟合到由此产生的重心目标上。在标准正则（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种简单的两步方法BROT：先计算未正则化的最优传输方案，再用深度神经网络对所得重心目标进行最小二乘回归，从而实现了兼具统计最优保证与实用可扩展性的最优传输映射估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BROT, a simple two-step method that first computes the unregularized optimal transport plan and then fits a deep neural network to the induced barycentric targets via least-squares regression, achieving statistically optimal and practically scalable estimation of optimal transport maps.
